# TeamClaw

> TeamClaw is an OpenClaw plugin that turns one or more OpenClaw instances into a virtual software company. One controller routes execution-ready work to role-based workers, blocks on real questions instead of guessing, and syncs everything through git.

TeamClaw is for teams and solo developers who already run OpenClaw and want it to behave like a software team rather than a chat window: work arrives as intake, becomes an execution-ready task, is routed to a role-based worker (PM, Software Architect, Developer, QA, Release Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, DevOps, Security, UI/UX, Marketing, Data), and ships through git with its evidence attached. When a role cannot safely continue it raises a clarification instead of guessing.

Key facts:
- Runs as an OpenClaw plugin; minimum OpenClaw version 2026.3.24, Node 22+.
- Eleven role-based workers coordinated by one controller; a clarification-first task flow.
- Four deployment topologies: process workers on one host, Docker, Kubernetes, and external worker nodes.
- Desktop app (TeamClaw Desktop) for macOS, Windows and Linux: https://github.com/topcheer/teamclaw/releases/tag/desktop-latest
- No lock-in on state: the workspace is git-backed and nothing important lives only in a chat transcript.
- License: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 only (AGPL-3.0-only). Source is available; if you run a modified version as a network service, you must offer that version's complete source code to its users.

## Install

```bash
npx -y @teamclaws/teamclaw install
```

Requires an OpenClaw host with at least one working model configuration.
